message.content:
The exchange rate between the U.S. dollar (USD) and the British pound (GBP) fluctuates constantly, but as of the most recent market data (late 2023 – early 2024) the rate is roughly:

**1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**

Using that rate:

```
$20 × 0.78 GBP/USD ≈ £15.60
```

So, **$20 is approximately £15.60**.  

> **Note:**  
> • Exchange rates change every minute, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly depending on when you convert.  
> • If you need a precise figure for a specific transaction, check a reliable financial news source or your bank’s current rate.
